label: Pi, DSH and Devin share an uncached p50 of 160-165 ms and p95 of 237-264 ms, while Claude's uncached p95 is 618 ms, 2.3-2.6x theirs, tracking the three-start process chain.
The brief costs about 68 tokens per prompt in a fresh-session population (270.6 bytes mean, 262 median, 316 p95), with 99 percent carrying the full 219-byte directive.
The started command's document read is about 1,131 tokens median and 3,143 p95, 16.6 times the brief, so prompt-level overhead is not where a prompt's cost lives.

Three cells stay inferred with one confirming measurement each: cold first prompt (unload and run one prompt), process-chain ceiling (run the three hooks in host order), amortized brief (five prompts in one session).
No measured cell exceeds a runtime budget: worst live p95 618 ms against 2,500 (24.7 percent), worst live row 1,538 (61.5 percent), cold measured work 690 ms.
